Hi Elaine — thanks for the heads-up and the CSV, that helps. We can definitely accommodate a compressed format next week. Quick proposal:

- Primary slot: Tue 2026-06-15, 10:00–11:30 PT (90 minutes) — covers exec highlights + 20 min for decision items.
- Backup (shorter): Wed 2026-06-16, 09:00–10:00 PT (60 minutes) — exec-only highlights, technical follow-up scheduled after.

Run-of-show (high level):
- 0–10m: exec goals and success signals
- 10–40m: roadmap highlights + near-term rollout plan
- 40–65m: performance & cost implications (batching/quantization highlights)
- 65–80m: open decisions / procurement timing
- 80–90m: next steps and owners

Laura will be backup for the technical portion if we need to split post-demo deep-dive. Marissa will send the calendar invite and a DocuSign amendment link for the contracted demo date once you confirm. For procurement — can you confirm if a PO number will be available before the session, or does procurement require the DocuSign amendment first?

Attaching a slightly trimmed run-of-show so you can share it with your execs. If the exec team truly only wants 60 minutes, we can compress items and deprioritize the technical cost deep-dive.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this.
